G4722: to roof over, i.e. (figuratively) to cover with silence (endure patiently)
G2106: to think well of, i.e. approve (an act); specially, to approbate (a person or thing)
G2641: to leave down, i.e. behind; by implication, to abandon, have remaining
G3441: remaining, i.e. sole or single; by implication, mere
G2532: and, also, even, so then, too, etc.; often used in connection (or composition) with other particles or small words
G3992: to dispatch (from the subjective view or point of departure, whereas (as a stronger form of ) refers rather to the objective point or terminus ad quem , and denotes properly, the orderly motion involved), especially on a temporary errand; also to transmit, bestow, or wield
G5095: dear to God; Timotheus, a Christian
G3588: the (sometimes to be supplied, at others omitted, in English idiom)
G80: a brother (literally or figuratively) near or remote (much like )
G1249: an attendant, i.e. (genitive case) a waiter (at table or in other menial duties); specially, a Christian teacher and pastor (technically, a deacon or deaconess)
G2316: figuratively, a magistrate; by Hebraism, very
G2098: a good message, i.e. the gospel
G5547: anointed, i.e. the Messiah, an epithet of Jesus
G1519: to or into (indicating the point reached or entered), of place, time, or (figuratively) purpose (result, etc.); also in adverbial phrases
G4741: to set fast, i.e. (literally) to turn resolutely in a certain direction, or (figuratively) to confirm
G3870: to call near, i.e. invite, invoke (by imploration, hortation or consolation)
G4012: properly, through (all over), i.e. around; figuratively with respect to; used in various applications, of place, cause or time (with the genitive case denoting the subject or occasion or superlative point; with the accusative case the locality, circuit, matter, circumstance or general period)
G4102: persuasion, i.e. credence; moral conviction (of religious truth, or the truthfulness of God or a religious teacher), especially reliance upon Christ for salvation; abstractly, constancy in such profession; by extension, the system of religious (Gospel) truth itself
G4525: to wag (as a dog its tail fawningly), i.e. (generally) to shake (figuratively, disturb)
G3778: the he (she or it), i.e. this or that (often with article repeated)
G846: the reflexive pronoun self, used (alone or in the comparative ) of the third person , and (with the proper personal pronoun) of the other persons
G1063: properly, assigning a reason (used in argument, explanation or intensification; often with other particles)
G1492: used only in certain past tenses, the others being borrowed from the equivalent and ; properly, to see (literally or figuratively); by implication, (in the perfect tense only) to know
G4314: a preposition of direction; forward to, i.e. toward (with the genitive case, the side of, i.e. pertaining to; with the dative case, by the side of, i.e. near to; usually with the accusative case, the place, time, occasion, or respect, which is the destination of the relation, i.e. whither or for which it is predicated)
G4302: to say beforehand, i.e. predict, forewarn
G3195: to intend, i.e. be about to be, do, or suffer something (of persons or things, especially events; in the sense of purpose, duty, necessity, probability, possibility, or hesitation)
G1096: to cause to be ("gen"-erate), i.e. (reflexively) to become (come into being), used with great latitude (literal, figurative, intensive, etc.)
G1223: through (in very wide applications, local, causal, or occasional)
G2504: so also the dative case , and accusative case and (or also, even, etc.) I, (to) me
G1097: to "know" (absolutely) in a great variety of applications and with many implications (as follow, with others not thus clearly expressed)
G3985: to test (objectively), i.e. endeavor, scrutinize, entice, discipline
G2873: a cut, i.e. (by analogy) toil (as reducing the strength), literally or figuratively; by implication, pains
G2064: to come or go (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively)
G575: "off," i.e. away (from something near), in various senses (of place, time, or relation; literal or figurative)
G2097: to announce good news ("evangelize") especially the gospel
G26: love, i.e. affection or benevolence; specially (plural) a love-feast
G2192: to hold (used in very various applications, literally or figuratively, direct or remote; such as possession; ability, contiuity, relation, or condition)
G3842: every when, i.e. at all times
G1971: to dote upon, i.e. intensely crave possession (lawfully or wrongfully)
G3708: by extension, to attend to; by Hebraism, to experience; passively, to appear
G1909: properly, meaning superimposition (of time, place, order, etc.), as a relation of distribution (with the genitive case), i.e. over, upon, etc.; of rest (with the dative case) at, on, etc.; of direction (with the accusative case) towards, upon, etc.
G318: constraint (literally or figuratively); by implication, distress
G3568: "now" (as adverb of date, a transition or emphasis); also as noun or adjective present or immediate
G1437: a conditional particle; in case that, provided, etc.; often used in connection with other particles to denote indefiniteness or uncertainty
G4739: to be stationary, i.e. (figuratively) to persevere
G2962: supreme in authority, i.e. (as noun) controller; by implication, Master (as a respectful title)
G5101: an interrogative pronoun, who, which or what (in direct or indirect questions)
G2169: gratitude; actively, grateful language (to God, as an act of worship)
G3739: the relatively (sometimes demonstrative) pronoun, who, which, what, that
G5463: to be "cheer"ful, i.e. calmly happy or well-off; impersonally, especially as salutation (on meeting or parting), be well
G1715: in front of (in place (literally or figuratively) or time)
G2250: day, i.e. (literally) the time space between dawn and dark, or the whole 24 hours (but several days were usually reckoned by the Jews as inclusive of the parts of both extremes); figuratively, a period (always defined more or less clearly by the context)
G5228: "over", i.e. (with the genitive case) of place, above, beyond, across, or causal, for the sake of, instead, regarding; with the accusative case superior to, more than
G4053: superabundant (in quantity) or superior (in quality); by implication, excessive; adverbially (with ) violently; neuter (as noun) preeminence
G1189: to beg (as binding oneself), i.e. petition
G4383: the front (as being towards view), i.e. the countenance, aspect, appearance, surface; by implication, presence, person
G2675: to complete thoroughly, i.e. repair (literally or figuratively) or adjust
G3962: a "father" (literally or figuratively, near or more remote)
G2424: Jesus (i.e. Jehoshua), the name of our Lord and two (three) other Israelites
G3598: a road; by implication, a progress (the route, act or distance); figuratively, a mode or means
G4121: to do, make or be more, i.e. increase (transitively or intransitively); by extension, to superabound
G4052: to superabound (in quantity or quality), be in excess, be superfluous; also (transitively) to cause to superabound or excel
G2588: the heart, i.e. (figuratively) the thoughts or feelings (mind); also (by analogy) the middle
G3952: a being near, i.e. advent (often, return; specially, of Christ to punish Jerusalem, or finally the wicked); (by implication) physically, aspect
G3326: properly, denoting accompaniment; "amid" (local or causal); modified variously according to the case (genitive association, or accusative succession) with which it is joined; occupying an intermediate position between or and or ; less intimate than and less close than )
G40: sacred (physically, pure, morally blameless or religious, ceremonially, consecrated)
